bullets.text: Under supervision, implemented reusable Python modules for the research abstract metadata workflow and wrote regression tests for malformed and edge-case inputs.
Under supervision, joined research abstract identifiers to metadata using SQL, checked unmatched records, visualized group comparisons, and documented missing-data handling.
As an individual contribution to a supervised course project, wrote Python functions for parsing provided product review records and tested transformations on hand-checked input examples.

Under supervision, compared dictionary coding with nonnegative-matrix-factorization topic exploration for public product reviews, examined topic stability across repeated fits, and inspected documents supporting each interpretation.
Under supervision, joined product review identifiers to metadata using SQL, checked unmatched records, visualized group comparisons, and documented missing-data handling.
As an individual contribution to supervised team research, wrote Python functions for parsing provided news summary records and tested transformations on hand-checked input examples.
Under supervision, joined news summary identifiers to publication metadata using SQL, checked unmatched records, visualized group comparisons, and documented missing-data handling.
